sentences.en: Air provides considerable thermal insulation when trapped in a chamber.
sentences.zh: 当空气被困在一个隔间里时，它能提供相当好的隔热效果。

sentences.en: Before noon only women are admitted into the thermal baths.
sentences.zh: 中午之前，只有女性可以进入温泉浴室。

sentences.en: Yellowstone Park has many thermal areas of geysers and mud pots.
sentences.zh: 黄石公园有许多含有热泉和泥坑的区域。
